items.name: Emergency Services — 999
items.description: Call 999 for Police, Fire or Ambulance in any life-threatening emergency. This is the UK's main emergency number — free to call from any phone.

items.name: Police Non-Emergency — 101
items.description: Call 101 for non-emergency police matters — lost property, minor incidents, reporting suspicious activity. Not for life-threatening situations.

items.name: NHS Medical Helpline — 111
items.description: Call 111 for urgent medical advice that is not life-threatening. Available 24/7. Also available online at 111.nhs.uk for non-urgent queries.

items.name: University College Hospital
items.description: One of London's major NHS teaching hospitals with a 24/7 Accident & Emergency department. Nearest A&E to Central London.

items.name: Common Tourist Scams
items.description: Watch out for: fake street sellers, petition scammers near tourist spots, overcharging taxis, fake TfL staff asking for payment. Always use licensed black cabs or Uber.

items.name: British Transport Police
items.area: All London stations and the Tube
items.description: Report crime on public transport, trains and the London Underground. Text 61016 or call 0800 40 50 40. Look for officers on platforms and concourses.
items.address: All London train stations and Underground
